title: Day 4. Posting proof I’m thriving.
caption: Day 4 and Leo is on take 87 of a 'thriving' selfie, crying. You don't owe anyone proof that you're okay. Put the phone down, call someone real, and heal where nobody's watching. Send this to the friend posting through it.
